name: Hide2Less Compatibility
tagline: 为 Hide2Less 转换后的 Rootless 插件提供所需的兼容支持。
notice: 仅在转换后的插件提示需要 compat 时安装。此包适用于 Rootless；先安装本包，再安装对应插件。
description: Hide2Less 转换结果按需使用的独立兼容包，没有独立界面。
同一设备安装一次，多款需要 compat 的转换后插件可以共用。
features: 为需要 compat 的 Hide2Less 转换结果提供共享兼容支持
支持从 Banana 源自动下载依赖，或使用 Hide2Less 导出的安装包手动安装
compatibility: 最低 iOS 15，仅 Rootless 环境
只有转换结果声明依赖时才需要安装，不代表所有插件都能兼容
usage: 添加并刷新 Banana 源 https://iyaway.github.io/，让包管理器在安装需要它的插件时下载本包。
也可从 Hide2Less 的“分享兼容包”导出，与插件一起分发；先安装 compat，再安装插件。

changes: 首次发布，为需要 compat 的 Hide2Less 转换结果提供共享兼容支持。

en.name: Hide2Less Compatibility
en.tagline: Shared compatibility support for Rootless tweaks converted by Hide2Less.
en.notice: Install only when a converted tweak requires compat. This package is for Rootless. Install it before the corresponding tweak.
description: A separate compatibility package used when required by Hide2Less conversion results, without a standalone interface.
Install once on a device and share it across converted tweaks that require compat.
features: Shared compatibility support for Hide2Less conversion results that require compat
Download automatically from the Banana repository or install the package exported by Hide2Less manually
compatibility: Requires iOS 15 or later and a Rootless environment
Needed only when declared as a dependency; does not guarantee compatibility for every tweak
usage: Add and refresh the Banana repository at https://iyaway.github.io/ so your package manager can download this dependency when needed.
Alternatively, use Share compatibility package in Hide2Less and distribute it with the tweak. Install compat first, then the tweak.

changes: Initial release with shared compatibility support for Hide2Less conversion results that require compat.
